content: Exfoliation can refer to several distinct processes depending on the context: 1. In botany, exfoliation refers to the shedding or loss of leaves from a plant. In some cases, it may also describe the detachment of pieces of bark from the plant. 2. In cosmetology, exfoliation is a technique used to remove dead skin cells from the surface of the skin, typically on the face and body, to improve skin texture and appearance. 3. In geology, exfoliation describes a weathering process in which layers or sheets of rock are removed due to physical or chemical factors. 4. In material science, exfoliation refers to the process by which particle aggregates are broken apart into smaller components or individual layers.
